scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the confirmed cross-country navigation-log lab usable by ensuring the assigned current sectional chart is available before its equipment check.
Emerging Need: The chart is missing, but it matters only after the lab format resolves from a possible packet exercise into a confirmed route-planning practicum.
Decision Context: Stored material records identify the exact chart, missing status, paper-only rule, and allowable purchase boundary; live notices supply funds, verified source, stock, and the short hold window.
Consequence: A timely same-day hold preserves the future lab path, while inventory closure leaves no approved chart source before check-in.

parameter.subject: Friday nav lab format pending
parameter.body: Friday's Lesson 23 planning block is still being split between a classroom packet exercise and a live route-planning practicum. Route assignment and any materials note will follow after noon; do not rely on earlier supply chatter.

parameter.title: Lesson 23 cross-country nav-log lab
parameter.description: Confirmed live route-planning practicum for the KALB-KPOU training route. Equipment check at 15:05; bring assigned current chart, plotter, and calculator. Materials table closes at 14:30.
Reserved cash converted for March training supplies, including navigation lab materials.

parameter.name: VFC Pilot Shop Counter
parameter.notes: Directory sync marks this as the verified club source for learner charts; accepts remote card prepay and same-day counter holds when inventory notice lists a SKU.

parameter.content: Counter inventory update: two New York Sectional 2026-A charts, SKU NYSEC-26A, are available at $14.25 including tax. Same-day hold/prepay requests received by 16:30 today will be pulled before the Thursday-Friday audit closure; pickup can be at Friday classroom materials table.

parameter.subject: Chart counter audit lock
parameter.body: The pilot-shop audit lock has started. Remaining New York Sectional 2026-A stock is sealed with weekend inventory; new holds or prepays will not be opened until Monday morning. Friday classroom materials table will carry only items already pulled before lock.
